description: Symbol cleanup compiled to the neural ISA: the cosine of a vector with every row of memory.relations.codebook, the best row, and whether it reaches the threshold selected by a one-hot mode (cleanup 0.3, same symbol 0.9, pronoun 0.4). Used for symbol interning (with a gate, the row to append when a name has no codebook entry) and resolving 'it' from the discourse state. Thresholds equal model/specs/reasoning.json.
